import java.io.*;

public class Main {
	static final long mod = 1000000007;
	static final long inv = 570000004;
	static int add(int a, int b) {
		int ret = a + b;
		return ret < mod ? ret : ret - mod;
	}
	static int sub(int a, int b) {
		int ret = a - b;
		return ret >= 0 ? ret : ret + mod;
	}
	static int mul(int a, int b) {
		return (int) ((long) a * b % mod);
	}

	static class Dwarf {
		int id;
		boolean[] state;

		public Dwarf(int id, boolean[] state) {
			this.id = id;
			this.state = state.clone();
		}
	}

	static class Translator {
		static boolean[] clone(boolean[] bs) {
			boolean[] res = new boolean[128];
			for (int i = 0; i < 128; ++i) res[i] = bs[i];
			return res;
		}

		static boolean[] logicAnd(boolean a[], boolean b) {
			boolean[] res = new boolean[128];
			for (int j = 0; j < 128; ++j) {
				if (!a[j]) continue;
				for (int k = j; ; k ^= k & -k) {
					if (b[j ^ k & -k]) {
						a[j ^ k & -k] ^= true;
						break;
					}
				}
				res[j] = a[j];
			}
			return res;
		}

		static int dfsTranslator(TreeMap<Dwarf, Integer> name, int root, List<Dwarf> stack) {
			int nextId = stack.size();
			stack.add(new Dwarf(nextId, clone(new boolean[128])));
			name.put(stack.get(stack.size() - 1), nextId);
			for (Dwarf cur: name.keySet()) if (cur.id != root) {
				boolean[] mask = new boolean[128];
				mask[127 - cur.id] = true;
				for (Dwarf next: name.keySet()) if (next.id != root && next.id != cur.id) {
					boolean[] state = stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state;
					boolean[] mask2 = logicAnd(state.clone(), mask);
					boolean[] logicOr = logicOr(mask, mask2);
					boolean[] tmp = logicOr(cur.state, mask2);
					if (name.containsKey(new Dwarf(next.id, tmp))) continue;
					stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state = tmp;
					mask2(cur.state, tmp);
					name.put(next, nextId = stack.size());
					stack.add(new Dwarf(nextId, clone(tmp)));
					break;
				}
			}
			return nextId;
		}

		static boolean[] logicOr(boolean[] a, boolean[] b) {
			boolean[] res = new boolean[128];
			for (int j = 0; j < 128; ++j) res[j] = a[j] || b[j];
			return res;
		}
	}

	public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
		PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
		int n = in.nextInt();
		HashMap<Dwarf, Integer> name = new HashMap<>();
		List<Dwarf> stack = new ArrayList<>(), list = new ArrayList<>();
		stack.add(new Dwarf(0, new boolean[128]));
		for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) for (int row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
			stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state[127 - row] = true;
			int j = in.nextInt();
			stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state[127 - row] = false;
			stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state[(127 - i) & 127] = true;
			stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state[(127 - i) & 127] = false;

			stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state[(127 - i) & 127] = true;

				for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {

						cur[k] = false;
						for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
							if ((i >> l & 1) == 0) cur[l] |= stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state[l];
						}
						break;

			}

		for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) for (int j = 0; j < list.size(); ++j) stack.add(list.get(j));
		int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][list.size()];
		dp[0][0] = 1;
		for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) for (int j = 0; j < list.size(); ++j) for (int k = 0; k < (1 << n); ++k) 
			dp[i][Translator.name.get(new Dwarf(j, curaload(k)))] = add(dp[i][name.get(new Dwarf(j, Translator.curaload(k)))], mul(dp[i - 1][j], q[i - 1][k]));
		boolean[] res = new boolean[128];
		for (int i = 0; i < 128; ++i) res[i] = true;
		out.println(dp[n][name.get(new Dwarf(0, res))]);
		out.flush();
	}

	static boolean[] curaload(int i) {
		boolean[] ret = new boolean[128];
		stack.clear();
		stack.add(new Dwarf(0, new boolean[128]));
		for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {

			Translator.logicOr(stack.get(stack.size() - 1).state, Translator.curaload((i >> j & 1) == 0 ? j : 127 - j));
